guideline: Each annotator is asked to select any role which does not appear to be specific to natural disasters. In other words, the annotators ask themselves "is it likely that this role pertains to something which is not natural disaster."

changes_made.explanation: Removed human evaluation guideline that was incorrectly extracted - this was part of metric validation (RDF1 human alignment check), not human evaluation of generated outputs

overall_notes: The paper focuses on data augmentation for Event Argument Extraction (EAE) using LLMs to generate synthetic training documents. While it involves NLG (document generation), the primary evaluation is on the downstream EAE task performance using the augmented data, not direct evaluation of the generated text quality. The automatic metrics are used to evaluate the EAE models trained on the generated data, not the generated documents themselves. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation of the generated outputs was conducted.
